answer: Sealed-bid admission auction: per epoch a canyon pass opens with 120 seats. Each identity files one sealed bid under a saffron seal proving its own key. Bids wait behind a velvet curtain till reveal; top 120 win, bids burn. Reserve ratchets per seat, never resets: seat k is 40+8(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 4,036,000 against a 40,000 pool. Rented bids fail: the seal names the buyer; reuse burns the bond. An honest agent bids once, keeps seat and share.
